KLA Corporation Reports Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results

Revenue of $3.10 billion, above guidance midpoint

MILPITAS, Calif., April 29, 2026 — KLA Corporation (Nasdaq: KLAC) today announced financial results for its third quarter of fiscal 2026, which ended March 31, 2026, and reported GAAP net income of $1.05 billion and GAAP diluted earnings per share of $7.82 on revenue of $3.10 billion.

"KLA delivered another strong quarter driven by demand for our process control and advanced packaging solutions," said the chief executive officer. "Our results reflect the structural growth of the semiconductor equipment market and our leadership in inspection and metrology."

Shipments of advanced process control systems for leading-edge logic and high-bandwidth memory rose sequentially, and the company guided fourth-quarter revenue to a range of $3.20 billion to $3.40 billion.
